scope: local development observations; not exact-SHA Verify receipts

observations.failure: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed while deleting a recommendation referenced by record-mail drafts
observations.resolution: Clear the reference and stale affected drafts in the same contact-erasure transaction; the native probe completed afterward.

observations.failure: Owner, recipient, goal and stop fields lacked concise accessible names; native acceptance posted to the wrong trailing-slash route
observations.resolution: Explicit accessible names and the mounted native root; later probe accepted the obligation through the built form.

observations.failure: Delegated consent required fresh sign-in after the ten-minute window; no confirmation mail was configured in that fixture
observations.resolution: A real owner email-link request and confirmation refresh the fixture session; production freshness checks stay unchanged.

observations.failure: archive_export_active refused to replace an immutable snapshot retained by an earlier section
observations.resolution: List and discard the actor’s prior completed transfer through the existing native archive abort door before preparing the new snapshot.

observations.failure: Existing risk record did not load before its deadline while native and browser jobs ran together; retired fixture contexts continued polling
observations.resolution: Sequential runtime checks and closing owned browser contexts after each completed fixture phase; no timeout or assertion weakened.

observations.stage: full native registration after both restores
observations.failure: Replay was refused as policy_unavailable because the signed company policy expired during the archive section
observations.resolution: Refresh the same held policy through its real signed policy door, then keep the exact subject_erased assertion; no policy lifetime or authority rule changed.
